name: kodflow-hud
description: Optional heads-up display beside the status line, as a mod (function hooks, Claude Code 2.1.293 or later): a Tasks pane with the open epics of kodflow-hooks' task list as a tree (subtasks, blockers, the critical path, the worker, model and effort on each task, the time since it last moved, a silent flag, the tasks waiting on the person) or as a graph by state, driven by keys and clicks, a clicked row or tab never moving from under the pointer; the only pane, so always the first tab and the one shown, its title counting the tasks left (the subagents are Claude Code's own list under the prompt); toasts for a task done, blocked or gone silent; a few words of each reply drawn in colour where the model marks them ({{r:…}} red, {{o:…}} orange, {{v:…}} green, {{p:…}} pink), the convention given in one system prompt section. Two more views beside the tree and the graph: « Refus », what kodflow-hooks refused (blocks.jsonl), newest first, the counts of the last hour and of the session, and a rule the person confirms with a click added to the project's .claude/settings.local.json; « Documents », the project's documents (docs.json) present, missing or ignored, a click ignoring or bringing one back in docs/manifest.json, « Créer » drafting the docs prompt in the prompt box, never sent. No tool, no refusal; KODFLOW_COLORS=off turns off the colours and the section.

silentMinutes.title: Silent after (minutes)
silentMinutes.description: A task in progress with no activity from its worker for this long is flagged silent and toasted once.

autoOpen.title: Open the panes at start
autoOpen.description: Open the Tasks pane when a session starts. The engine seats an unasked pane only from 144 columns; /hud opens them at any width.

ci.title: CI of cited pull requests
ci.description: Every 5 minutes at most, ask gh pr checks about the GitHub pull request URLs that an open task cites, and show the result beside the task.
